description: Protection-Paladin-with-Discipline-flavor tank - one-hand-and-shield block chassis, sustained by Justicar's Wrath self-healing, The Chosen's Illumination-fed shields, and avoidance/crit procs rather than active button-mashing.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Chosen of the Light, Sol Invictus, Dawnbreak, Dawnfall, Solar Nova confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Solar Power spikes from Gavel strikes, Dawnbreak, crits (Sun Warrior's Guidance), and Vow fulfillment (Dawnguard), gating recurring empowered Dawn effects via Angelic Presence. Defense is mostly resource-free and automatic - block, avoidance procs, Justicar's Wrath self-heal, The Chosen shields off Illumination.

nodes.name: Sun-Touched Armor
nodes.description: Grants Armor from Strength and Intellect, and increases total Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Level 20 Passive. Armor from Strength+Intellect; boosts total Stamina.'

nodes.name: Battle Priest
nodes.description: Grants Armor contribution from Spirit, increases block value, and reduces Magic damage taken by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Armor contribution from Spirit; boosts block value; reduces Magic damage taken.'

nodes.name: Holy Strength
nodes.description: Increases spell power from Strength by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Level 30 Passive. Spell power from Strength.'

nodes.name: Gavel of Light
nodes.description: Learn Gavel of Light, a weapon strike that self-heals for a percentage of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'Smash an enemy for 100% Weapon Damage plus 12 and heal yourself equal to 50% of the damage dealt. Shares a cooldown with other Gavels.' Seraphim's real self-sustain generator.

nodes.name: Bulwark of the Sun
nodes.description: Increases block value by 4% per rank, and teaches Sun Shield.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts block value; teaches Sun Shield.'

nodes.name: Seraphic Bulwark
nodes.description: Learn Seraphic Bulwark, a cooldown that boosts block value for a number of blocks or duration.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: '2 charges, 25-sec recharge. Boosts block value for a number of blocks or duration.' Seraphim's real burst-mitigation cooldown.

nodes.name: Clarity of the Heavens
nodes.description: Increases block value from Intellect by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Level 50 Passive. Boosts block value from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Stand Against Darkness
nodes.description: Reduces spell damage taken by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Scroll of Hope
nodes.description: Reduces party and raid Magic damage taken. Anyone below 35% health during it receives a one-time heal.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Seraphim's capstone raid-utility cooldown: 'Reduces party/raid Magic damage taken; anyone below 35% health during it gets a one-time heal.'

nodes.name: Justicar's Wrath
nodes.description: Learn Justicar's Wrath, high-threat Holy damage that increases the target's spell damage taken.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'High-threat Holy damage + boosts target's spell damage taken.' Seraphim's core threat generator.

nodes.name: Adjudicator
nodes.description: Justicar's Wrath deals bonus damage to the target and nearby enemies, and heals you for a percentage of damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Justicar's Wrath deals bonus damage to target+nearby, heals you (10% of damage dealt).' Seraphim's real self-sustain engine.

nodes.name: Angelic Presence
nodes.description: Avoiding an attack has a chance to grant a defensive buff.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Avoiding an attack chance to grant a buff.'

nodes.name: The Chosen
nodes.description: Illumination shields you for a percentage of the amount healed.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Illumination shields you (% of amount healed).' Real Discipline-Atonement-flavored self-shield off self-healing.

nodes.name: Bastion of Hope
nodes.description: Critical strikes regenerate mana and increase all primary stats for a duration.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Crits regen mana + boost all primary stats.'

nodes.name: Hammer of Kings
nodes.description: Learn Hammer of Kings, an encircling aura that repeatedly deals Holyfire damage to nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Encircling aura: repeating Holyfire damage to nearby enemies.' Seraphim's real multi-mob threat/damage tool.

nodes.name: Seraphim
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Gavel of Light, Horusath Blast, and Dawnbreak by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Reduces Gavel of Light/Horusath Blast/Dawnbreak cooldowns.'

nodes.name: Dawnbreak
nodes.description: Learn Dawnbreak, a frontal shield-radiated Holyfire damage spell that scales with block value.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot (class-wide entry, but functionally Seraphim's real AoE identity per the handoff doc): 'Radiate holy light from your shield on enemies in front of you, dealing Holyfire Damage, scaling with your block value.'

nodes.name: Sol Invictus
nodes.description: Increases threat generated, with additional threat from Holy and Fire spells and abilities.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'Your devotion to the sun knows no bounds, increasing your threat generated by 85% plus an additional 90% from Holy and Fire spells and abilities.'

nodes.name: Devoted
nodes.description: Dawnbreak and Gavel of Light strike 2 additional nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 50 Passive. Dawnbreak/Gavel of Light strike 2 extra nearby enemies.'

nodes.name: Solar Eclipse
nodes.description: Dawnbreak unleashes a delayed Holy burst on all struck enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Dawnbreak unleashes a delayed Holy burst.'

nodes.name: Solar Nova
nodes.description: Learn Solar Nova, an AoE Holy burst guaranteed to critically strike Undead or Demons, reducing Solar Invocation cooldown per target struck.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'Emit a powerful holy light in an 8 yd radius, dealing 168 Holy damage to all nearby enemies. Reduces the cooldown of your Solar Invocation spells by 1 sec for each target struck. This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead or Demons.'

nodes.name: Shining Shield
nodes.description: Increases Armor contribution from your shield by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Armor contribution from shield.'

nodes.name: Gleaming Armor
nodes.description: Reduces spell damage taken by 3% per rank, with an additional reduction above 80% health.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces spell damage taken (extra above 80% health).'

nodes.name: Sun Warrior's Guidance
nodes.description: Increases Gavel and Dawnbreak critical strike chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Gavels/Dawnbreak crit chance.'

nodes.name: Guarded By The Light
nodes.description: Direct magic damage taken has a chance to restore health periodically.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Direct magic damage taken chance to restore health periodically.'

nodes.name: Injunction
nodes.description: Learn Injunction, taunting a target enemy.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Taunts a target.'
